title: "Goodness-of-Fit Rejection Rates"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    theme: cosmo
execute:
  echo: false

---

This report compares parametric-bootstrap goodness-of-fit results for the
Gamma and $\mathcal{G}^0_I$ distributions using five samples per land-cover
class. The null hypothesis is rejected when the p-value is below 0.01.

The heatmap shows the percentage of samples rejecting the null hypothesis
within each mission, polarization, class, and model combination. NISAR uses
polarizations HH and HV; Sentinel-1 uses VV and VH.

```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
  windowsFonts(
    TimesNewRoman = windowsFont("Times New Roman"),
    CambriaMath = windowsFont("Cambria Math")
  )
}

alpha <- 0.01
sample_ids <- c("B", "R", "W", "U", "G")
class_names <- c(Fo = "Forest", Sv = "Savanna", Gl = "Grassland")
input_files <- c(
  list.files(file.path("Data", "pnb_samples", "nisar", "n_200"),
             pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE),
  list.files(file.path("Data", "pnb_samples", "sentinel_1"),
             pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
)
data_signature <- tools::md5sum(input_files)
```

```{r load-data, cache=TRUE, cache.extra=data_signature}
load_samples <- function(directory, intensity_columns) {
  prefixes <- c("Fo", "Sv", "Gl")
  images <- unlist(lapply(prefixes, function(prefix) {
    paste0(prefix, sample_ids)
  }), use.names = FALSE)

  samples <- lapply(images, function(image) {
    filename <- paste0(substr(image, 1, 2), "_", substring(image, 3), ".csv")
    read_csv(file.path(directory, filename),
             show_col_types = FALSE)
  })
  names(samples) <- images

  missing_columns <- unique(unlist(lapply(samples, function(sample) {
    setdiff(intensity_columns, names(sample))
  })))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop("Missing intensity columns: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
  }
  samples
}

nisar_samples <- load_samples(
  file.path("Data", "pnb_samples", "nisar", "n_200"),
  c("IHH", "IHV")
)
sentinel_samples <- load_samples(
  file.path("Data", "pnb_samples", "sentinel_1"),
  c("IVV", "IVH")
)
```

```{r test-functions, cache=TRUE}
ks_gamma <- function(x, shape, rate, mission) {
  x <- sort(x)
  n <- length(x)
  fitted_cdf <- pgamma(x, shape = shape, rate = rate)

  if (mission == "NISAR") {
    max(abs(ecdf(x)(x) - fitted_cdf))
  } else {
    i_min <- rank(x, ties.method = "min")
    i_max <- rank(x, ties.method = "max")
    max(i_max / n - fitted_cdf, fitted_cdf - (i_min - 1) / n)
  }
}

fit_gamma <- function(x, mission) {
  if (mission == "NISAR") {
    estimates <- MASS::fitdistr(x, densfun = "gamma")$estimate
    c(shape = unname(estimates[1]),
      rate = unname(estimates[1]) / unname(estimates[2]))
  } else {
    scale <- mean(x)
    fit <- MASS::fitdistr(x / scale, densfun = "gamma")$estimate
    c(shape = unname(fit["shape"]), rate = unname(fit["rate"]) / scale)
  }
}

test_gamma <- function(x, mission, B) {
  estimate <- fit_gamma(x, mission)
  observed <- ks_gamma(x, estimate["shape"], estimate["rate"], mission)
  simulated <- numeric(B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    xb <- rgamma(length(x), shape = estimate["shape"],
                 rate = estimate["rate"])
    estimate_b <- fit_gamma(xb, mission)
    simulated[b] <- ks_gamma(
      xb, estimate_b["shape"], estimate_b["rate"], mission
    )
  }

  (1 + sum(simulated >= observed)) / (B + 1)
}

loglik_G0 <- function(alpha, gamma, L, z) {
  n <- length(z)
  n * (lgamma(L - alpha) - alpha * log(gamma) - lgamma(-alpha)) +
    L * sum(log(z / (gamma + L * z))) +
    alpha * sum(log(gamma + L * z))
}

initial_G0 <- function(z, L) {
  m1 <- mean(z)
  m2 <- mean(z^2)
  cc <- (m2 / m1^2) * L / (L + 1)
  a <- if (cc > 1) (2 * cc - 1) / (cc - 1) else 100
  a <- min(max(a, 2.5), 500)
  c(alpha = -a, gamma = m1 * (a - 1))
}

fit_G0 <- function(z, L, initial = NULL) {
  scale <- mean(z)
  zs <- z / scale
  if (is.null(initial)) {
    initial <- initial_G0(zs, L)
  } else {
    initial["gamma"] <- initial["gamma"] / scale
  }

  par0 <- c(log(-initial[["alpha"]]), log(initial[["gamma"]]))
  if (!all(is.finite(par0))) par0 <- c(log(5), log(5 * L))
  par0[1] <- min(par0[1], log(500))

  objective <- function(p) {
    value <- -loglik_G0(-exp(p[1]), exp(p[2]), L, zs)
    if (is.finite(value)) value else 1e300
  }
  optimum <- optim(
    par0, objective, method = "L-BFGS-B",
    lower = c(log(1.01), log(1e-6)),
    upper = c(log(500), log(1e6))
  )
  c(alpha = -exp(optimum$par[1]), gamma = exp(optimum$par[2]) * scale)
}

pG0 <- function(z, alpha, gamma, L) {
  pbeta(L * z / (gamma + L * z), shape1 = L, shape2 = -alpha)
}

rG0 <- function(n, alpha, gamma, L) {
  v <- rbeta(n, shape1 = L, shape2 = -alpha)
  gamma * v / ((1 - v) * L)
}

ks_G0 <- function(x, alpha, gamma, L, mission) {
  x <- sort(x)
  fitted_cdf <- pG0(x, alpha, gamma, L)

  if (mission == "NISAR") {
    max(abs(ecdf(x)(x) - fitted_cdf))
  } else {
    n <- length(x)
    i_min <- rank(x, ties.method = "min")
    i_max <- rank(x, ties.method = "max")
    max(i_max / n - fitted_cdf, fitted_cdf - (i_min - 1) / n)
  }
}

test_G0 <- function(x, L, mission, B) {
  estimate <- fit_G0(x, L)
  observed <- ks_G0(x, estimate[["alpha"]], estimate[["gamma"]], L, mission)
  simulated <- rep(NA_real_, B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    xb <- rG0(length(x), estimate[["alpha"]], estimate[["gamma"]], L)
    estimate_b <- tryCatch(
      fit_G0(xb, L, initial = estimate),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(estimate_b)) {
      simulated[b] <- ks_G0(
        xb, estimate_b[["alpha"]], estimate_b[["gamma"]], L, mission
      )
    }
  }

  if (mission == "Sentinel-1") simulated <- simulated[is.finite(simulated)]
  (1 + sum(simulated >= observed)) / (length(simulated) + 1)
}
```

```{r run-tests, cache=TRUE, dependson=c("load-data", "test-functions"), cache.extra=tools::md5sum(input_files)}
mission_settings <- list(
  NISAR = list(
    samples = nisar_samples,
    bands = c(HH = "IHH", HV = "IHV"),
    enl = c(HH = 3.3795, HV = 3.4487),
    B = 1000
  ),
  `Sentinel-1` = list(
    samples = sentinel_samples,
    bands = c(VV = "IVV", VH = "IVH"),
    enl = c(VV = 2.0574, VH = 2.0788),
    B = 999
  )
)

run_mission_tests <- function(mission, settings) {
  samples <- settings$samples
  bands <- settings$bands
  B <- settings$B
  class_prefixes <- substr(names(samples), 1, 2)
  classes <- unname(class_names[class_prefixes])

  set.seed(2024)
  gamma_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(samples), function(i) {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(names(bands), function(polarization) {
      data.frame(
        Mission = mission,
        Class = classes[i],
        Polarization = polarization,
        Model = "Gamma",
        p_value = test_gamma(
          samples[[i]][[bands[[polarization]]]], mission, B
        )
      )
    }))
  }))

  set.seed(2024)
  g0_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(samples), function(i) {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(names(bands), function(polarization) {
      data.frame(
        Mission = mission,
        Class = classes[i],
        Polarization = polarization,
        Model = "G0",
        p_value = test_G0(
          samples[[i]][[bands[[polarization]]]],
          settings$enl[[polarization]], mission, B
        )
      )
    }))
  }))

  rbind(gamma_results, g0_results)
}

results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(mission_settings), function(mission) {
  run_mission_tests(mission, mission_settings[[mission]])
}))
results$Rejected <- results$p_value < alpha
```

```{r rejection_rates}
rejection_rates <- aggregate(
  Rejected ~ Mission + Polarization + Class + Model,
  data = results,
  FUN = mean
)
rejection_rates$Percentage <- 100 * rejection_rates$Rejected
rejection_rates$Class <- factor(
  rejection_rates$Class,
  levels = c("Forest", "Savanna", "Grassland"),
  labels = c("Fo", "Sv", "Gl")
)
rejection_rates$Polarization <- factor(
  rejection_rates$Polarization,
  levels = c("VH", "VV", "HV", "HH")
)

rejection_rates$Model <- factor(
  rejection_rates$Model,
  levels = c("Gamma", "G0"),
  labels = c("Gamma", "G0")
)

model_labels <- c(
  Gamma = "<span style='font-family: TimesNewRoman; font-style: italic;'>Γ</span><sub>SAR</sub>",
  G0 = "<span style='font-family: CambriaMath;'>𝒢</span><sup>0</sup><sub>I</sub>"
)

p_rejection_rates <- ggplot(
  rejection_rates,
  aes(x = Class, y = Polarization, fill = Percentage)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(format(Percentage, trim = TRUE), "*'%'"),
                color = Percentage >= 80),
            size = 12 / (72.27 / 25.4), parse = TRUE,
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "grey20")) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#ffffff", "#f6b89c", "#e0734a", "#b3261e"),
    limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
    title = "Rejected samples (%)",
    title.position = "right",
    barheight = grid::unit(6, "cm"),
    title.theme = element_text(
      angle = 90, family = "TimesNewRoman", size = 12
    )
  )) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
  facet_grid(Mission ~ Model, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(Model = model_labels),
             switch = "y") +
  labs(
    title = "Goodness-of-fit null hypothesis rejection rates",
    subtitle = "Parametric bootstrap; significance level = 1%; 5 samples per cell",
    x = "Class", y = "Polarization"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12, base_family = "TimesNewRoman") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = ggtext::element_markdown(
      size = 12, face = "plain", family = "TimesNewRoman"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_blank()
  )

print(p_rejection_rates)

ggsave(
  filename = "rejection_rates.png",
  plot = p_rejection_rates +
    labs(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle = element_blank()
    ),
  device = "png",
  width = 178 / 25.4,
  height = 106.8 / 25.4,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

The percentage is the number of rejected sample-level tests divided by five.
It is therefore reported in increments of 20 percentage points. A lower rate
means fewer samples rejected the model's goodness-of-fit null hypothesis; it
does not by itself establish spatial homogeneity.
